# Ganesh Murali

> Frontend & Mobile Developer with 3+ years of experience building web and React Native mobile applications. Currently a Software Engineer (Frontend) at AstroKure AI Private Limited, working on an AI-powered astrology platform (web + iOS/Android).

Ganesh Murali is a frontend and mobile developer based in Chennai, India, specializing in React.js, React Native, Next.js, and TypeScript. He also works on UI/UX design, WordPress/CMS development, and CRM/ERP integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Shopify).
